tiers.name: Standard
tiers.body: It runs at full power, then shuts off. Reliable, with the lowest price of the three.

tiers.name: Comfort
tiers.hook: Quieter, and better at pulling moisture out of the air.
tiers.body: It runs on low most of the time. The house stays a more even temperature and feels less sticky, which matters a lot in Miami.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.hook: The quietest, and the best at humidity.
tiers.body: It speeds up and slows down a little at a time, like cruise control. Very steady temperature, very quiet, and the lowest power bills of the three.

addons.name: Soft start kit
addons.why: Helps your system start up gently. Less strain on the parts, and the lights don't flicker when it turns on.
addons.problem: Every time your AC turns on, it pulls a big jolt of power. In Miami it turns on many times a day, all year long.
addons.fix: A soft start kit makes every start gentle. Less wear on the compressor (the most expensive part), quieter starts, and no flickering lights.

addons.name: Second drain pan + safety switch
addons.why: If the drain ever clogs, the switch turns the AC off before water can leak into your home.
addons.problem: Miami humidity means your AC pulls gallons of water out of the air every day. If the drain line clogs, that water can overflow into your ceiling or closet.
addons.fix: A second pan catches the overflow, and the safety switch shuts the AC off before water reaches your home. You'd call us about a warm house, not a wet ceiling.

addons.name: Surge protector
addons.why: Protects the outside unit from power surges and lightning.

addons.name: Smart thermostat
addons.why: Change the temperature from your phone and set a schedule.

addons.name: UV light
addons.why: Helps stop mold and germs from growing on the inside coil.
addons.problem: Miami heat and humidity keep the coil inside your AC cold and wet all day. That's just what mold likes, and it can cause a musty smell when the AC turns on.
addons.fix: A UV light shines on the coil and helps stop mold and germs from growing there. The coil stays cleaner, the air smells fresher, and your system doesn't have to work as hard.

addons.name: Hard start kit
addons.why: Gives the system an extra push to start. Most new systems don't need one. We'll tell you if yours does.
